= kprobe =
	1. attach
		* b.attach_kprobe(event="vfs_unlink", fn_name="trace_req_start")
		* trace_req_done(struct pt_regs *ctx, struct dentry *dentry, struct inode **delegated_inode) // first argument is struct pt_regs *ctx
= data =	
	1. BPF_HASH(start, u32)
	2. BPF_ARRAY(avg, u64, 2)
= inline function =
	1. bpf_probe_read_kernel(&pid, sizeof(next->pid), &next->pid)
	2. bpf_get_smp_processor_id();
